canonical_title: Reflecting Responsibilities and Accountabilities in Personal Work Goals (CBLM 5)
aliases: Reflecting individual responsibilities and accountabilities in personal work goals and plans
Responsibilities and accountabilities in personal work goals

one_line_answer.text: Your personal work goals, plans and activities should reflect your own responsibilities and accountability.

cites.quote: Your personal work goals, plans and activities should reflect your own responsibilities and accountability.

keywords.bn: দায়িত্ব — যে কাজ আপনাকে করতেই হবে

bangla_explanation: নিজের work goals-এ responsibilities আর accountability না দেখালে কেউ সেই plans বিশ্বাস (trust) করবে না।
প্রতিষ্ঠানের plans-ও নিজের work plan-এ রাখুন; না রাখলে কাজ most efficient business path থেকে সরে যেতে পারে।
একটা goal-এর পাশে আরও ২-৩টা goals বা 'b' plans রাখলে আপনার foresight বোঝা যায়।
Goals বাড়িয়ে নিলে (extend) আপনার ও প্রতিষ্ঠানের, দুজনেরই better performance and strength হয়।

example.en: A workshop instructor must keep tool records. His yearly work plan includes a monthly tool-record check.
example.bn: Job description-এ যে দায়িত্ব আছে, work plan-এও সেটা লক্ষ্য হিসেবে লিখুন।

labels_bn: প্রথমে প্রতিষ্ঠানের requirements কী, তা খুঁজে বের করুন।
নিজের job description পড়ে বুঝে নিন — আপনার responsibilities আর accountabilities কী।
এরপর নিজের personal work goals and plans তৈরি করুন।
সেই goals and plans-এ নিজের responsibilities ও accountabilities দেখান, প্রতিষ্ঠানের requirements মেনে।

short.prompt: Why should your personal work goals reflect your responsibilities and the organisation's plans?
short.modelAnswer:
Personal work goals, plans and activities should reflect your own responsibilities and accountability.
1. Otherwise no one would trust them.
2. Every plan and decision should benefit the organisation and staff.
3. Without the organisation's plans, your actions may deviate from the most efficient business path.
4. Extending your goals gives all round better performance and strength.

keyPoints.text: If your goals do not reflect responsibility or accountability, no one would trust them.

cites.quote: If your personal work goals do not reflect or indicate that you are
responsible or accountable for your plans or actions, no one would trust them.

keyPoints.text: Every plan and decision must consider how it will benefit the organization and staff.

cites.quote: every plan, step forward, decision, and organizational operations must
be taken into account in reference to how each will benefit the organization and staff.

keyPoints.text: Without the organisation's plans, your actions may deviate from the most efficient business path.

cites.quote: If you do not incorporate these plans into your own thinking and work plan
and actions may deviate from the most efficient business path

keyPoints.text: Extending work goals beyond those planned gives all round better performance and strength.

cites.quote: your personal work goals beyond those originally planned, are all round better
performance and strength.

keyPoints.text: Having 2-3 goals based on your first goal shows foresight and 'b' plans.

cites.quote: you could also have 2 - 3
goals based on your first goal, and that would then demonstrate that you not only had
foresight, but you have other avenues and possible 'b' plans
